scanNote:
4-UNITNING BESHINCHI BETI (30-bet). Yuqori qismi OCH BINAFSHA fonli.

Chapda to'q sariq 'Reading & Listening' sarlavhasi. To'rtta CHIZMA RASM (A - D):
• A - havo sharining savatida turgan ayol va erkak, orqada yashil maysazor
• B - havo shari savatidagi ikki kishi; chapda BINAFSHA CHAQMOQ chizilgan
• C - daraxtga ilinib qolgan sariq havo shari; savatda odamlar
• D - qizil O'T O'ChIRISh MAShINASI, chiroqlari yonmoqda

O'ng tomonda katta qora harflar bilan 'Up, Up and Away!' sarlavhasi va och sariq fonli, yirtilgan qog'oz shaklidagi HIKOYA (ikki ustunda).
Matn ichida oltita raqamlangan bo'shliq (1 - 6).
Qalin harfli so'zlar: picked ... up, ride, rise, cheerfully, replied, shook violently, worried face, landed, branch, brightly, had in mind.

Pastda oq fonda:
21) 'Look at the pictures. Which shows:' beshta band, har birining oldida KATAKChA: a hot-air balloon hanging from a tree branch?; someone reaching for a radio?; someone climbing into a hot-air balloon basket?; a bright flash of lightning?; a fire engine?
22) a) 'Read the story and fill in the numbered gaps with verbs from the list. Then, explain the words in bold.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: were standing, were hanging, was blowing, were flashing, was taking, was wailing.
   b) 'Correct the sentences, as in the example.' Beshta gap; 1-gapga ko'k qiya javob berilgan.
   c) 'Read the story again and underline the phrases which describe sounds.'
23) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen to the story and number the sentences in the correct order.' To'qqizta gap; uchtasiga ALLAQAChON raqam qo'yilgan (8, 1, 5).
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Close your books and try to give a summary of the story.'
24) 'Complete the sentences.' Beshta yarim gap: when, As, when, While, while so'zlari QALIN harflarda.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '30'.

exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYaNING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI
bandlarda berilgan (bo'shliqlar
to'ldirilgan holda).


⚠ SARLAVHA: 'UP, UP AND AWAY!'

  = Yuqoriga, yuqoriga va uzoqqa!
  ⚠ Bu - mashhur qo'shiq nomi
  (1967-yil, 'Up, Up and Away' -
  havo shari haqida).
  ⚠ Takrorlangan 'up' - ko'tarilish
  hissini beradi.


HIKOYaNING TUZILIShI
(29-betdagi quti bo'yicha):

  BOShLANISh:
     WHEN: 'As soon as Fay woke up ...
        It was a sunny morning'
     WHO: Fay va uning do'sti Bob
     WHAT FIRST: 'Bob picked her up in
        his car'

  ASOSIY QISM:
     havo shariga chiqish → momaqaldiroq
     → chaqmoq → Fay boshini urish →
     daraxtga qo'nish → o't o'chiruvchilar

  TUGASh:
     WHAT IN THE END: 'Fay and Bob were
        standing safely on the ground'
     HOW FELT: "We're safe at last!"


⚠ ZAMONLAR - 4-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI:

  PAST CONTINUOUS (fon):
     'a gentle breeze WAS BLOWING'
     'Dark clouds WERE RACING towards
      them'
     'they WERE HANGING from a branch'
     'Its siren WAS WAILING'
     'its red lights WERE FLASHING'

  PAST SIMPLE (voqealar):
     'Fay WOKE UP', 'Bob PICKED her up',
     'they CLIMBED into the basket',
     'the balloon BEGAN to rise',
     'Fay FELL backwards and HIT her
      head'


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  to pick sb up - borib olmoq
  a ride        - sayr (transportda)
  to rise       - ko'tarilmoq
  cheerfully    - quvnoq
  to reply      - javob bermoq
  to shake violently - qattiq silkinmoq
  a worried face - xavotirli yuz
  to land       - qo'nmoq
  a branch      - shox
  brightly      - yorqin
  to have in mind - ko'zda tutmoq

points.en: As soon as Fay woke up, she knew this birthday was going to be very special. It was a sunny morning and a gentle breeze was blowing in through the window.
points.uz: Fey uyg'onishi bilanoq bu tug'ilgan kun juda alohida bo'lishini bildi. Quyoshli tong edi va derazadan mayin shabada esib turardi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'as soon as' = ... ishi bilanoq.
⚠ 'was going to be' - o'tmishdagi kelajak
(5-unit mavzusi).
⚠ 'was blowing' - FON → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'a breeze' = mayin shabada.

points.en: "A perfect day for a balloon ride!" Fay said excitedly to herself.
points.uz: "Havo sharida sayr qilish uchun mukammal kun!" - dedi Fey o'ziga hayajon bilan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'excitedly' - RAVISh ('excited' + -ly).
⚠ 'to say to oneself' = o'ziga aytmoq (o'ylamoq).
⚠ 'a ride' = sayr (transportda).

points.en: Half an hour later, her friend Bob picked her up in his car. For her birthday present, Bob, a pilot, was taking Fay for a ride in a hot-air balloon.
points.uz: Yarim soatdan keyin do'sti Bob uni mashinasida olib ketdi. Tug'ilgan kun sovg'asi sifatida uchuvchi Bob Feyni havo sharida sayrga olib bormoqchi edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to pick sb up' = borib olmoq.
⚠ 'was taking' - REJALAShTIRILGAN ish
(past continuous kelajak ma'nosida).
⚠ 'Bob, a pilot,' - IZOh, verguller bilan.

points.en: Fay was thrilled when she saw the huge, bright yellow hot-air balloon. Bob made sure that everything was okay, then they climbed carefully into the basket.
points.uz: Fey ulkan, yorqin sariq havo sharini ko'rganda juda xursand bo'ldi. Bob hamma narsa joyidaligiga ishonch hosil qildi, keyin ular ehtiyotkorlik bilan savatga chiqishdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'thrilled' - 28-betdagi 15-mashqda ham bor edi.
⚠ 'huge' - 28-betdagi 9-mashqda.
⚠ SIFATLAR TARTIBI: huge (o'lcham) → bright
yellow (rang) → hot-air (tur) → balloon.

points.en: Moments later, the balloon began to rise slowly into the air. "This is fantastic!" she shouted cheerfully to Bob.
points.uz: Bir necha lahzadan keyin shar sekin havoga ko'tarila boshladi. "Bu ajoyib!" - deb qichqirdi u Bobga quvnoq ohangda.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to rise' - O'TIMSIZ: rise - rose - risen
(o'zi ko'tariladi).
⚠ 'to raise' - O'TIMLI: biror narsani ko'tarmoq.
⚠ 'cheerfully' - RAVISh.

points.en: "Happy Birthday! I'm glad you like your present!" he replied.
points.uz: "Tug'ilgan kuning bilan! Sovg'ang yoqqanidan xursandman!" - javob berdi u.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to reply' = javob bermoq (27-betdagi
hikoyada ham bor edi).
⚠ "I'm glad (that) you like ..." - 'that'
tushirib qoldiriladi.

points.en: Suddenly, the smile disappeared from Bob's face. Dark clouds were racing towards them and, before he could say anything, there was a loud rumble of thunder.
points.uz: To'satdan Bobning yuzidan tabassum yo'qoldi. Qora bulutlar ular tomon shitob bilan kelayotgan edi va u biror narsa aytishga ulgurmasidan momaqaldiroq gumburladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Suddenly' - voqeaning burilish nuqtasi.
⚠ 'were racing' - FON → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'a rumble of thunder' - 28-betdagi 14-mashqda
'thunder rumbling' bor edi.

points.en: The balloon shook violently from side to side. "Oh, no!" screamed Fay. "We're going to die!"
points.uz: Shar u yoqdan-bu yoqqa qattiq silkindi. "Voy!" - qichqirdi Fey. "Biz o'lamiz!"
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'shook' - 'shake' ning o'tgan zamoni
(shake - shook - shaken).
⚠ 'violently' - 28-betdagi 11-mashqda.
⚠ "We're going to die" - DALILGA asoslangan
taxmin (5-unit mavzusi).

points.en: Just as Bob was reaching for the radio, there was a bright flash of lightning. Fay fell backwards and hit her head, and everything went black.
points.uz: Bob radioga qo'l cho'zayotgan paytda yorqin chaqmoq chaqdi. Fey orqasiga yiqildi va boshini urdi, hammasi qorayib ketdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Just as ... was reaching' (uzun) +
'there was' (qisqa) - 17-mashqning 'c'
qo'llanishi.
⚠ 'lightning' = chaqmoq (YoRUG'LIK);
'thunder' = momaqaldiroq (TOVUSh).
⚠ 'everything went black' = hushidan ketdi.

points.en: When Fay opened her eyes, she saw Bob's worried face in front of her. "Are you alright?" he asked anxiously.
points.uz: Fey ko'zini ochganda oldida Bobning xavotirli yuzini ko'rdi. "Yaxshimisan?" - so'radi u xavotir bilan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'worried' = xavotirlangan.
⚠ 'anxiously' - RAVISh; 'anxious' 28-betdagi
15-mashqda bor edi.
⚠ 'in front of' = oldida.

points.en: "The balloon went down," he explained, "but fortunately we've landed in a tree. I've already radioed for help."
points.uz: "Shar pastga tushdi", - tushuntirdi u, "lekin yaxshiyamki daraxtga qo'ndik. Men allaqachon yordam so'rab radio orqali xabar berdim".
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'fortunately' = yaxshiyamki (13-betdagi
matnda ham bor edi).
⚠ "we've landed", "I've radioed" - PRESENT
PERFECT: natijasi hozir ham bor.
⚠ 'to radio' - OT ham, FE'L ham.

points.en: Fay looked over the side of the basket and realised that they were hanging from a branch. "Don't worry," said Bob calmly. "It'll hold us."
points.uz: Fey savatning chetidan qaradi va ularning shoxga ilinib turganini angladi. "Xavotir olma", - dedi Bob xotirjam. "U bizni ushlab turadi".
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'were hanging' - FON → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'a branch' = shox.
⚠ 'calmly' - RAVISh; 'calm' da 'l' O'QILMAYDI.
⚠ "It'll" = 'it will' - taxmin.

points.en: At that moment a fire engine appeared. Its siren was wailing and its red lights were flashing brightly.
points.uz: Shu payt o't o'chirish mashinasi paydo bo'ldi. Sirenasi uvillayotgan va qizil chiroqlari yorqin miltillayotgan edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'appeared' (qisqa) + 'was wailing',
'were flashing' (uzun) - IKKI zamon birga.
⚠ 'a siren wailing' - 28-betdagi 14-mashqda.
⚠ 'ITS' - apostrofsiz (egalik).

points.en: Two firefighters jumped out and, five minutes later, Fay and Bob were standing safely on the ground. "We're safe at last!" Fay cried.
points.uz: Ikki o't o'chiruvchi sakrab tushdi va besh daqiqadan keyin Fey bilan Bob yerda xavfsiz turishardi. "Nihoyat xavfsizmiz!" - deb xitob qildi Fey.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'were standing' - NATIJADAGI holat →
PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'safely' - RAVISh; 'safe' - SIFAT.
⚠ 'at last' = nihoyat.
⚠ 'to cry' bu yerda = xitob qilmoq (yig'lamoq
emas).

points.en: "Fay, I'm sorry," replied Bob. "It wasn't quite what I had in mind, but I'm sure you won't forget this birthday!"
points.uz: "Fey, kechir", - javob berdi Bob. "Bu men ko'zda tutgan narsa emas edi, lekin ishonchim komil, bu tug'ilgan kunni unutmaysan!"
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to have sth in mind' = ko'zda tutmoq.
⚠ 'quite' = butunlay (inkorda: 'unchalik emas').
⚠ "you won't forget" - kelajak haqida taxmin.
⚠ Bu gap UNIT NOMIGA ishora: 'Days to Remember'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. Which shows: a hot-air balloon hanging from a tree branch? someone reaching for a radio? someone climbing into a hot-air balloon basket? a bright flash of lightning? a fire engine?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang. Qaysi biri ko'rsatadi: daraxt shoxiga ilingan havo sharini? radioga qo'l cho'zayotgan odamni? havo shari savatiga chiqayotgan odamni? yorqin chaqmoqni? o't o'chirish mashinasini?
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT RASM - BESh BAND.

  ⚠ B rasmida IKKI narsa bor: chaqmoq
  va radioga qo'l cho'zayotgan odam.


RASMLAR:

  A - havo shari savatiga chiqayotgan
      ikki kishi (maysazorda)
  B - savatdagi ikki kishi; chapda
      binafsha ChAQMOQ; Bob radioga
      qo'l cho'zmoqda
  C - daraxtga ilinib qolgan sariq shar
  D - qizil o't o'chirish mashinasi


⚠ RASM TARTIBI HIKOYaGA MOS:

  A → B → C → D
  ⚠ Ya'ni rasmlar hikoyaning KETMA-
  KETLIGIni ko'rsatadi.


⚠ 'TO REACH FOR STH':

  = qo'l cho'zmoq.
  ⚠ 'to reach' (predlogsiz) = yetib
  bormoq (25-betdagi 8-mashqda).
  ⚠ 'to reach FOR' = qo'l cho'zmoq -
  BOShQA ma'no.


⚠ 'A FLASH OF LIGHTNING':

  = chaqmoq chaqishi.
  ⚠ 'lightning' - SANALMAYDIGAN,
  shuning uchun 'a flash of' kerak.
  ⚠ 'lightning' (chaqmoq) va
  'lightening' (yengillashtirish) -
  imlosi boshqa!


⚠ 'A FIRE ENGINE':

  = o't o'chirish mashinasi.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'a fire engine',
  AQShda 'a fire truck'.
  ⚠ 21-betdagi Harrods matnida
  'a fire brigade' bor edi.

pairs.left: a hot-air balloon hanging from a tree branch
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ C rasmida sariq shar daraxtga ilinib qolgan.
⚠ Matnda: 'we've landed in a tree ... they were
hanging from a branch'.

⚠ B rasmida Bob savatdagi radioga qo'l
cho'zmoqda.
⚠ 'to reach FOR sth' = qo'l cho'zmoq.

pairs.left: someone climbing into a hot-air balloon basket
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ A rasmida ikki kishi maysazorda savatga
chiqmoqda.
⚠ Matnda: 'they climbed carefully into the
basket'.

⚠ B rasmida chapda binafsha ChAQMOQ chizilgan.
⚠ B rasmi IKKI bandga to'g'ri keladi.
⚠ 'lightning' - SANALMAYDIGAN, 'a flash of'
kerak.

⚠ D rasmida qizil o't o'chirish mashinasi.
⚠ Britaniyada 'a fire engine', AQShda
'a fire truck'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story and fill in the numbered gaps with verbs from the list. Then, explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani o'qing va raqamlangan bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi fe'llar bilan to'ldiring. So'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI BO'ShLIQ - HAMMASI PAST
CONTINUOUS.

  ⚠ Ro'yxatdagi hamma fe'l
  'was/were + -ing' shaklida -
  ya'ni hammasi FON yoki DAVOM
  ETAYoTGAN ish.


⚠ 'WAS' yoki 'WERE' - EGAGA QARANG:

  1  'a gentle breeze' (birlik) → WAS
  2  'Bob' (birlik) → WAS
  3  'they' (ko'plik) → WERE
  4  'Its siren' (birlik) → WAS
  5  'its red lights' (ko'plik) → WERE
  6  'Fay and Bob' (ko'plik) → WERE

  ⚠ Ro'yxatda 'was' li uchta va 'were'
  li uchta fe'l bor - bu KATTA yordam.


⚠ HAR BO'ShLIQNING MA'NOSI:

  1  was blowing - shabada esardi (fon)
  2  was taking - olib bormoqchi edi
     (reja)
  3  were hanging - ilinib turishardi
     (holat)
  4  was wailing - sirena uvillayotgan
     edi
  5  were flashing - chiroqlar
     miltillayotgan edi
  6  were standing - turishardi (natija)


⚠ 2-BO'ShLIQ - QIZIQ HOLAT:

  'Bob WAS TAKING Fay for a ride'
  ⚠ Bu - REJALAShTIRILGAN ish
  (past continuous kelajak ma'nosida).
  ⚠ Xuddi 'I'm meeting friends tonight'
  kabi, lekin O'TMIShDA.


⚠ 4 va 5-BO'ShLIQLAR - 28-BET BILAN
BOG'LIQ:

  'a siren wailing' - 28-betdagi
  14-mashqda o'rganilgan edi.


⚠ 'TO FLASH':

  = miltillamoq, chaqnamoq.
  ⚠ 'a flash' (ot) = chaqnash.
  ⚠ 'a flash of lightning' - 21-mashqda.

items.sentence: It was a sunny morning and a gentle breeze ___ in through the window.
items.uz: Quyoshli tong edi va derazadan mayin shabada esib turardi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Ega 'a gentle breeze' - BIRLIK → 'was'.
⚠ FON tasviri → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'to blow' - 27-betdagi hikoyada ham bor edi.

items.sentence: For her birthday present, Bob, a pilot, ___ Fay for a ride in a hot-air balloon.
items.uz: Tug'ilgan kun sovg'asi sifatida uchuvchi Bob Feyni havo sharida sayrga olib bormoqchi edi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Ega 'Bob' - BIRLIK → 'was'.
⚠ REJALAShTIRILGAN ish - past continuous
kelajak ma'nosida.
⚠ 'to take sb for a ride' = sayrga olib bormoq.

items.sentence: Fay looked over the side of the basket and realised that they ___ from a branch.
items.uz: Fey savatning chetidan qaradi va ularning shoxga ilinib turganini angladi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Ega 'they' - KO'PLIK → 'were'.
⚠ HOLAT → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'to hang FROM sth' - predlog 'from'.

items.sentence: At that moment a fire engine appeared. Its siren ___ ...
items.uz: Shu payt o't o'chirish mashinasi paydo bo'ldi. Sirenasi uvillayotgan edi ...
items.whyUz:
⚠ Ega 'Its siren' - BIRLIK → 'was'.
⚠ 'a siren wailing' - 28-betdagi 14-mashqda
o'rganilgan.
⚠ 'ITS' - apostrofsiz (egalik).

items.uz: ... va qizil chiroqlari yorqin miltillayotgan edi.

items.sentence: Two firefighters jumped out and, five minutes later, Fay and Bob ___ safely on the ground.
items.uz: Ikki o't o'chiruvchi sakrab tushdi va besh daqiqadan keyin Fey bilan Bob yerda xavfsiz turishardi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Ega 'Fay and Bob' - KO'PLIK → 'were'.
⚠ NATIJADAGI holat → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'safely' - RAVISh; 'safe' - SIFAT.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  1  Bob picked Fay up in his taxi.
     → "Bob DIDN'T pick her up in his
        taxi. He PICKED her up in his
        CAR."

  ⚠ IKKI QADAM: avval INKOR, keyin
  TO'G'RI ma'lumot.


⚠ QAYSI FE'L BILAN INKOR:

  Gapdagi FE'LGA qarang:

  PAST SIMPLE → didn't + ODDIY fe'l
     'picked' → "didn't pick"
     'hit' → "didn't hit"
     'shook' → "didn't shake"
     'appeared' → "didn't appear"

  PAST CONTINUOUS → wasn't/weren't +
     -ing
     'were hanging' → "weren't hanging"

  ⚠ 4-band YaGONA past continuous gap -
  shuning uchun inkori boshqacha.


TO'G'RI MA'LUMOTLAR:

  1  his CAR (taxi emas)
  2  her HEAD (leg emas)
  3  VIOLENTLY (gently emas)
  4  from a BRANCH (roof emas)
  5  a FIRE ENGINE (police car emas)


⚠ 'DIDN'T' DAN KEYIN FE'L ODDIY:

  "didn't SHAKE" ('didn't shook' XATO)
  "didn't HIT" ('didn't hit' - 'hit'
     o'zgarmaydi, shuning uchun bir xil
     ko'rinadi)

  ⚠ 'shake' - noto'g'ri fe'l:
  shake - shook - shaken.
exercises.exampleEn: Bob picked Fay up in his taxi. - Bob didn't pick her up in his taxi. He picked her up in his car.
exercises.exampleUz: Bob Feyni taksisida olib ketdi. - Bob uni taksisida olib ketmadi. U uni mashinasida olib ketdi.
modelAnswers: Bob didn't pick her up in his taxi. He picked her up in his car.
Fay didn't hit her leg. She hit her head.
The balloon didn't shake gently from side to side. It shook violently.
They weren't hanging from a roof. They were hanging from a branch.
A police car didn't appear. A fire engine appeared.
modelAnswersUz: Bob uni taksisida olib ketmadi. U uni mashinasida olib ketdi.
Fey oyog'ini urmadi. U boshini urdi.
Shar sekin silkinmadi. U qattiq silkindi.
Ular tomdan ilinib turmagan edi. Ular shoxdan ilinib turishgan edi.
Politsiya mashinasi paydo bo'lmadi. O't o'chirish mashinasi paydo bo'ldi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story again and underline the phrases which describe sounds.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani qayta o'qing va tovushni tasvirlaydigan iboralar tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYaDAGI TOVUShLAR.

  ⚠ 28-betdagi 14-mashqda tovush
  fe'llari o'rganilgan edi - bu yerda
  ular MATNDA ishlatilgan.


TO'RT TOVUSh IBORASI:

  1) 'a loud RUMBLE OF THUNDER'
     = momaqaldiroqning gumburlashi
     ⚠ 14-mashqda 'thunder rumbling'.

  2) 'she SHOUTED cheerfully'
     = quvnoq qichqirdi

  3) '"Oh, no!" SCREAMED Fay'
     = qichqirdi (qo'rquvdan)

  4) 'Its SIREN WAS WAILING'
     = sirenasi uvillayotgan edi
     ⚠ 14-mashqda 'a siren wailing'.

  ⚠ Yana: 'Fay CRIED' = xitob qildi.


⚠ 'TO SHOUT' va 'TO SCREAM':

  to shout = baland ovozda gapirmoq
     (xursandchilikdan ham bo'lishi
     mumkin)
  to scream = chinqirmoq (qo'rquv,
     og'riq)

  ⚠ Hikoyada ikkalasi ham bor va
  farqi ANIQ ko'rinadi:
     'This is fantastic!' → SHOUTED
     'Oh, no! We're going to die!' →
        SCREAMED


⚠ 'TO CRY' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) yig'lamoq
  2) xitob qilmoq, baqirmoq

  ⚠ Hikoyada IKKINChI ma'noda:
  "'We're safe at last!' Fay CRIED."


⚠ 'A RUMBLE':

  = gumburlash.
  ⚠ 'to rumble' (fe'l) - 28-betdagi
  14-mashqda.
  ⚠ 'a rumble OF thunder' - 'thunder'
  sanalmaydigan, shuning uchun 'of'.

points.en: a loud rumble of thunder
points.uz: momaqaldiroqning baland gumburlashi
points.noteUz:
⚠ 28-betdagi 14-mashqda 'thunder rumbling'
bor edi.
⚠ 'thunder' SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a rumble OF'.

points.en: she shouted cheerfully to Bob
points.uz: u Bobga quvnoq qichqirdi
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to shout' = baland ovozda gapirmoq
(xursandchilikdan ham bo'ladi).
⚠ 'cheerfully' - RAVISh.

points.en: "Oh, no!" screamed Fay
points.uz: "Voy!" - chinqirdi Fey
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to scream' = chinqirmoq (QO'RQUVdan).
⚠ 'shout' bilan farqni sezing: bu yerda
QO'RQUV, oldingisida XURSANDChILIK.

points.en: Its siren was wailing
points.uz: Sirenasi uvillayotgan edi
points.noteUz:
⚠ 28-betdagi 14-mashqda 'a siren wailing'
bor edi.
⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS - davom etayotgan tovush.

points.en: "We're safe at last!" Fay cried.
points.uz: "Nihoyat xavfsizmiz!" - deb xitob qildi Fey.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to cry' bu yerda = XITOB QILMOQ,
yig'lamoq EMAS.
⚠ Kontekst ma'noni aniqlaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the story and number the sentences in the correct order.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani tinglang va gaplarni to'g'ri tartibda raqamlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'QQIZ VOQEA - TO'G'RI TARTIB.

  ⚠ Kitobda UChTA raqam ALLAQAChON
  qo'yilgan: 1 (Fay woke up), 5 (Fay
  hit her head), 8 (A fire engine
  appeared).

  ⚠ Javoblar hikoyada bor - mashqni
  AUDIOSIZ ham bajarish mumkin.


TO'G'RI TARTIB:

  1  Fay woke up.  (BERILGAN)
  2  Bob picked Fay up in his car.
  3  They climbed into the basket of
     the balloon.
  4  The balloon shook violently from
     side to side.
  5  Fay hit her head.  (BERILGAN)
  6  The balloon landed in a tree.
  7  Bob radioed for help.
  8  A fire engine appeared.  (BERILGAN)
  9  Firefighters helped Bob & Fay to
     the ground.


⚠ QANDAY TEKShIRILADI:

  Berilgan raqamlar ORALIQNI
  cheklaydi:
     1 va 5 orasida UChTA voqea (2, 3, 4)
     5 va 8 orasida IKKITA voqea (6, 7)
     8 dan keyin BITTA voqea (9)

  ⚠ Bu - mantiqiy yechim usuli:
  berilgan javoblar qolganlarini
  cheklaydi.


⚠ 6 va 7-VOQEALAR TARTIBI:

  Matnda: 'we've LANDED in a tree.
  I've already RADIOED for help.'

  ⚠ Avval qo'ndi, KEYIN radio orqali
  xabar berdi - chunki 'already'
  qo'nishdan keyingi ishni bildiradi.


⚠ 'TO RADIO':

  = radio orqali xabar bermoq.
  ⚠ OT ham, FE'L ham.
  ⚠ 'radioed' - o'tgan zamon shakli
  ('radioD' emas, 'radioED').

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobda BERILGAN.
⚠ Matnning birinchi gapi: 'As soon as Fay woke
up ...'

pairs.right: Bob picked Fay up in his car.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: 'Half an hour later, her friend Bob
picked her up in his car.'

pairs.right: They climbed into the basket of the balloon.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: 'they climbed carefully into the
basket'.
⚠ A rasmi shu voqeani ko'rsatadi.

pairs.right: The balloon shook violently from side to side.
pairs.rightUz: Shar u yoqdan-bu yoqqa qattiq silkindi.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Momaqaldiroqdan KEYIN, Fey boshini urishidan
OLDIN.
⚠ 'shook' - 'shake' ning o'tgan zamoni.

⚠ Kitobda BERILGAN.
⚠ Matnda: 'Fay fell backwards and hit her head'.

pairs.right: The balloon landed in a tree.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: "we've LANDED in a tree".
⚠ C rasmi shu voqeani ko'rsatadi.

pairs.rightUz: Bob yordam so'rab radio orqali xabar berdi.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda: "I've ALREADY radioed for help" -
'already' qo'nishdan KEYINGI ishni bildiradi.
⚠ 'to radio' - OT ham, FE'L ham.

⚠ Kitobda BERILGAN.
⚠ D rasmi shu voqeani ko'rsatadi.

pairs.right: Firefighters helped Bob & Fay to the ground.
pairs.rightUz: O't o'chiruvchilar Bob va Feyni yerga tushirdi.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ OXIRGI voqea.
⚠ Matnda: 'five minutes later, Fay and Bob were
standing safely on the ground'.

exercises.instructionEn: Close your books and try to give a summary of the story.
exercises.instructionUz: Kitobingizni yoping va hikoyaning qisqacha mazmunini aytishga harakat qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
QISQAChA MAZMUN AYTISh.

  ⚠ 'a summary' = qisqacha mazmun.
  ⚠ 'to summarise' = qisqacha bayon
  qilmoq.


⚠ KITOBNI YoPISh NIMA UChUN MUHIM:

  Matnga qaramasdan gapirish - eng
  qiyin, lekin eng foydali mashq.
  Chunki bunda o'quvchi so'zlarni
  XOTIRASIDAN chiqaradi, o'qib
  bermaydi.

  ⚠ Bu 'retrieval practice' deb
  ataladi va ilmiy tadqiqotlarga
  ko'ra o'rganishning eng samarali
  usuli.


QISQAChA MAZMUN QANDAY TUZILADI:

  1) KIM va QAChON
     'It was Fay's birthday ...'
  2) NIMA BO'LDI (asosiy voqealar)
     'Bob took her for a balloon ride,
      but there was a storm ...'
  3) QANDAY TUGADI
     'Firefighters helped them and they
      were safe.'

  ⚠ TAFSILOTLARNI TAShLAB KETING -
  faqat ASOSIY voqealar.


⚠ ZAMON: PAST SIMPLE

  ⚠ Qisqacha mazmunda past continuous
  KAM ishlatiladi - chunki fon emas,
  VOQEALAR aytiladi.


⚠ 23-MAShQDAGI TO'QQIZ GAP -
TAYYoR MAZMUN:

  Ular hikoyaning skeletini beradi.
  Ularni bog'lovchilar bilan ulash
  kifoya: First, Then, After that,
  Finally.

points.en: It was Fay's birthday. She woke up and knew it was going to be special.
points.uz: Feyning tug'ilgan kuni edi. U uyg'ondi va bu kun alohida bo'lishini bildi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ KIM va QAChON - mazmunning boshlanishi.
⚠ PAST SIMPLE.

points.en: Her friend Bob, a pilot, picked her up in his car and took her for a ride in a hot-air balloon.
points.uz: Do'sti, uchuvchi Bob uni mashinasida olib ketdi va havo sharida sayrga olib bordi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Ikki voqea 'and' bilan bog'langan.
⚠ 'to take sb for a ride' - turg'un ibora.

points.en: At first everything was fine, but then dark clouds appeared and there was a storm.
points.uz: Avvaliga hammasi yaxshi edi, lekin keyin qora bulutlar paydo bo'ldi va bo'ron boshlandi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'at first ... but then ...' - qarama-qarshi
qo'yish qolipi.
⚠ Bu - hikoyaning BURILISh nuqtasi.

points.en: The balloon shook violently, Fay fell and hit her head, and the balloon landed in a tree.
points.uz: Shar qattiq silkindi, Fey yiqilib boshini urdi va shar daraxtga qo'ndi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Uch voqea vergul va 'and' bilan bog'langan.
⚠ Hammasi PAST SIMPLE.

points.en: Bob radioed for help and a fire engine came. In the end, firefighters helped them to the ground and they were safe.
points.uz: Bob yordam so'rab radio orqali xabar berdi va o't o'chirish mashinasi keldi. Oxir-oqibat o't o'chiruvchilar ularni yerga tushirdi va ular xavfsiz bo'lishdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'In the end' - xulosani boshlaydi
(29-betdagi quti).
⚠ QANDAY TUGADI - mazmunning oxiri.

exercises.explanationUz:
'WHEN', 'WHILE', 'AS' BILAN GAP.


⚠ QOIDA:

  WHILE / AS + PAST CONTINUOUS
     (uzun ish)
  WHEN + PAST SIMPLE
     (qisqa ish)

  ⚠ Lekin BOSh GAP teskari bo'ladi:

  'I WAS WALKING down the street WHEN
   I SAW an accident.'
     uzun ish → past continuous
     'when' dan keyin → past simple

  'WHILE I WAS LEAVING the shop, it
   STARTED to rain.'
     'while' dan keyin → past continuous
     bosh gap → past simple


⚠ BETDAGI BESh GAP:

  1  'I was walking down the street
     yesterday WHEN ...'
     → 'when' dan keyin PAST SIMPLE

  2  'AS I was leaving the shop, ...'
     → bosh gapda PAST SIMPLE

  3  'I was lying on the beach WHEN ...'
     → 'when' dan keyin PAST SIMPLE

  4  'WHILE I was eating my dinner last
     night, ...'
     → bosh gapda PAST SIMPLE

  5  'Jenny was typing a letter WHILE
     ...'
     → 'while' dan keyin PAST CONTINUOUS
        (ikki uzun ish BIR VAQTDA)


⚠ 5-BAND - BOShQAChA:

  'Jenny was typing a letter WHILE
   her boss WAS TALKING on the phone.'

  ⚠ Bu yerda IKKI UZUN ish bir vaqtda -
  17-mashqning 'a' qo'llanishi.
  ⚠ Shuning uchun 'while' dan keyin
  ham PAST CONTINUOUS.


⚠ 'AS' - IKKI MA'NO:

  1) ... paytda (= while)
     'AS I was leaving ...'
  2) chunki (= because)
     'AS it was raining, we stayed in.'

  ⚠ 28-betdagi 11-mashq namunasida ham
  birinchi ma'noda edi.


⚠ VERGUL QOIDASI:

  Ergash gap BOShDA bo'lsa - VERGUL:
     'While I was eating, the phone
      rang.'
  Ergash gap OXIRDA bo'lsa - vergul YO'Q:
     'The phone rang while I was eating.'

  ⚠ Betdagi 2 va 4-gaplarda vergul BOR -
  chunki ergash gap boshda.
exercises.exampleEn: I was walking down the street yesterday when I saw an old friend.
exercises.exampleUz: Kecha ko'chada ketayotganimda eski do'stimni ko'rib qoldim.
modelAnswers: I was walking down the street yesterday when I saw an old friend.
As I was leaving the shop, it started to rain.
I was lying on the beach when I heard someone shouting.
While I was eating my dinner last night, the telephone rang.
Jenny was typing a letter while her boss was talking on the phone.
modelAnswersUz: Kecha ko'chada ketayotganimda eski do'stimni ko'rib qoldim.
Kecha kechqurun kechki ovqat yeyayotganimda telefon jiringladi.
Jenni xat yozayotganda boshlig'i telefonda gaplashayotgan edi.

patterns.exampleEn: I was walking down the street when I saw an old friend.
patterns.exampleUz: Ko'chada ketayotganimda eski do'stimni ko'rib qoldim.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ UZUN ish → past continuous;
'when' dan keyin QISQA ish → past simple.

patterns.exampleEn: While I was eating my dinner, the telephone rang.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'while/as' dan keyin UZUN ish.
⚠ Ergash gap BOShDA bo'lsa - VERGUL ShART.

patterns.exampleEn: Jenny was typing a letter while her boss was talking on the phone.
patterns.exampleUz: Jenni xat yozayotganda boshlig'i telefonda gaplashayotgan edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ IKKI UZUN ish BIR VAQTDA - ikkalasi ham
past continuous (17-mashqning 'a' qo'llanishi).

patterns.exampleEn: Fay didn't hit her leg. She hit her head.
patterns.exampleUz: Fey oyog'ini urmadi. U boshini urdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ "didn't" dan keyin fe'l ODDIY shaklda.
⚠ To'g'rilashning ikki qadami.

patterns.formula: Its siren was wailing and its lights were flashing.
patterns.exampleEn: Its siren was wailing and its red lights were flashing brightly.
patterns.exampleUz: Sirenasi uvillayotgan va qizil chiroqlari yorqin miltillayotgan edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ikki ish bir vaqtda → ikkalasi past continuous.
⚠ 'ITS' - apostrofsiz (egalik).

groups.explanationUz: Hikoyada juda ko'p ravish bor - ular voqeani jonli qiladi.
Ikkalasi ham 'ko'tarilmoq/ko'tarmoq', lekin biri o'timli, biri o'timsiz.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ OT VA FE'L BIR XIL ShAKLDA
groups.explanationUz: Hikoyada bir necha so'z ham ot, ham fe'l bo'lib keladi.
